notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers. Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Starving Revenant trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
